basic_info.description: Sophisticated & serene, this luxury Pacific Heights view residence is a rare fusion of elegance, design, & eco-conscious living. Perched on a generous 35-ft-wide lot, the home offers breathtaking, unobstructed Bay & Alcatraz views from every lvl & seamlessly blends indoor & outdoor living across 1000+ sq ft of private decks & balconies. Clean lines, matte finishes, green outlooks & natural materials define the modern aesthetic, while architectural details like glowing glass stairs & terraces create a warm, inviting ambiance.  Completely rebuilt from the studs in 2012, including new foundations & seismic upgrades, this LEED-H Platium home's open floor plan fosters a healthy, connected lifestyle, w/expansive living spaces bathed in natural light, with your own private spa w/sauna & steam rm. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated, from bespoke design elements, advanced air quality & sound attenuation measures, to cutting-edge smart home technology & sustainable building features. This exceptional residence is as functional as it is beautiful, ideal for both relaxed family living & sophisticated entertaining. Located in one of SF's most coveted neighborhoods & across from Spreckles Gardens, this home offers unmatched privacy, panoramic views, & effortless elegance at every turn.
